Cc: Anna Cho <anna.cho@bluepeak.com>
Date: Tue, 25 Jul 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: BluePeak MSA redlines + insurance ask

Hi Laura,

Thanks for the demo last week. Legal at BluePeak ran through the MSA and the order form and came back with two insurance items that need to be resolved before we can finalize the order:

- Certificate of Insurance (COI) showing limits below: General Liability $5,000,000; Auto $1,000,000; Professional Liability / E&O $2,000,000; Cyber/Privacy insurance $2,000,000.
- Additional insured / endorsement: we need an additional insured endorsement naming “BluePeak Holdings, Inc., its parents, subsidiaries and affiliated entities" as Additional Insured on a primary and non-contributory basis. Our legal would like the endorsement text redlined (we attached proposed language to the MSA redlines).

Can you confirm: (a) whether Redwood can provide a COI with those limits and the requested endorsement (or a similarly scoped scheduled endorsement), (b) your carrier/broker contact details so our broker can coordinate, and (c) an estimated timeline for provision of the COI and any endorsement?

We attached our MSA redlines (BluePeak_MSA_Redlines.pdf) for reference. Ideally we’d like COI/endorsement within 10 business days of execution. If there are any limitations (waiver of subrogation, location limitations, or inability to provide blanket additional insured), please flag them now so we can surface to procurement.

Thanks—
Tom Hsu
Senior Contracts Manager
BluePeak Analytics

Tom—

Appreciate the clear list and the redlines. Quick update / proposed path forward:

1) Legal review: I’ve looped in Aditya (legal) to confirm whether we can accept the additional insured language as-is or whether we need to provide the scheduled endorsement wording instead.
2) Broker/insurer coordination: can you provide the name/email/phone for your broker or carrier contact? Our broker sometimes needs to coordinate directly with yours for endorsement wording to be issued.
3) Timeline: we can typically issue a COI within ~5 business days after execution if limits match our current policies; an endorsement (if required to be issued by carrier) can take longer (7–14 business days) depending on broker workload and carrier approval. We’ll aim to expedite where possible.

I attached a current copy of our order form for BluePeak to confirm the contract values (redwood_orderform_v3.pdf).

Next steps / asks for you: please send broker contact and confirm if 10 business days would be an acceptable target for a temporary COI while endorsement is finalized.

Best,

Tom / Hannah / Laura / Neha—

Quick legal response after reviewing the redlines and speaking with our broker: a few clarifications and proposed compromise below.

1) Additional Insured: we cannot offer a blanket endorsement that covers "parents, subsidiaries and affiliated entities" on a blanket basis. We can provide a scheduled additional insured endorsement that names "BluePeak Holdings, Inc. and its wholly owned subsidiaries and affiliates as specifically scheduled" or similar—limited to liabilities arising out of Redwood's performance under the MSA. I attached an insurer-ready endorsement template that our broker can provide to Edgewood for issuance.

2) Limits: our current carriers can meet the requested limits (GL $5M; Auto $1M; E&O $2M; Cyber $2M). Please confirm the legal entity name(s) you want listed exactly as they should appear on the COI/endorsement.

3) Waiver of Subrogation: we can accept a waiver of subrogation for General Liability where permitted by law; we need to confirm for E&O/cyber on a carrier-by-carrier basis.

4) Temporary COI: we are willing to issue a temporary COI naming BluePeak as additional insured for 30 days post-signature, with the expectation the full scheduled endorsement is issued within that 30-day window. Given broker turnaround, please expect endorsement issuance in 7–12 business days after carrier receipt of the endorsement form, assuming no carrier objections.

Action items:
- BluePeak / Edgewood: confirm exact entity name(s) to be scheduled on the endorsement.
- Edgewood / Redwood broker: coordinate directly using the attached endorsement template (endorsement_template_redwood.pdf).
- Laura / Neha: I recommend we capture the temporary COI commitment in the order form (short clause) so procurement has the temporary protection while endorsement is in process.

Aditya Rao
Senior Counsel, Contracts
Redwood Inference
